description: CropScape is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by George Mason University | Center for Spatial Information and Science Systems; NASA, National Aeronautics and Space Administration; USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service. CropScape displays data from the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Cropland Data Layer (CDL), an annual, remote-sensing snapshot of crop cover during the main growing season across the contiguous United States. Users can find crop-specific land cover data derived from satellite imagery and extensive ground truthing. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
